intro_en: In this lesson you'll learn how to talk about dropping your phone and cracking the screen. You'll also learn the Mongolian -ж орхих pattern for sudden or unintended actions, like унагаж орхилоо "I (accidentally) dropped it."
intro_mn: Энэ хичээлээр утсаа унагаж, дэлгэцээ хагалсан тухай ярьж сурна. Мөн англи хэлний get-passive буюу "my screen got cracked" гэх мэт санамсаргүй тохиолдсон үйлийг илэрхийлэх хэлбэрийг үзнэ.

vocab.example_en: When the phone fell, its screen cracked.
I dropped my phone on the bus.
The phone slipped out of my hand and fell.
It's hard to use a phone with a cracked screen.
I had a screen protector put on my new phone.

vocab.example_mn: Утасны гэр зузаан болохоор утас гэмтээгүй.
vocab.example_en: The phone wasn't damaged because the case is thick.
Is there a repair shop nearby?
I accidentally stepped on my phone.

sentences.en: I got pushed on the bus and dropped my phone.
alt_en: I got jostled on the bus and dropped my phone.

sentences.mn: Утас гараас минь гулсаад шууд асфальт дээр унасан.
sentences.en: The phone slipped out of my hand and fell right onto the asphalt.
alt_en: My phone slipped out of my hand and fell straight onto the pavement.
sentences.mn_latin: Utas garaas mini gulsaad shuud asfalit deer unasan.

sentences.en: The screen got cracked at the corner.
alt_en: The screen is cracked at the corner.

sentences.en: I regret not putting on a screen protector.
alt_mn: Хамгаалалтын шил наагаагүй байсандаа харамсаж байна.
alt_en: I regret not having put on a screen protector.

sentences.mn: Хагархай дэлгэцтэй утсаар мессеж бичихэд хэцүү байна.
sentences.en: It's hard to text on a phone with a cracked screen.
alt_en: Texting on a phone with a cracked screen is hard.
sentences.mn_latin: Khagarkhai delgetstei utsaar myessyej bichikhed khetsüü baina.

sentences.en: I accidentally stepped on my friend's phone.

sentences.mn: Засварын газар дэлгэц солиулахад хэд болох вэ?
sentences.en: How much does it cost to get the screen replaced at a repair shop?
alt_mn: Засварын газар дэлгэц солиулахад ямар үнэтэй вэ?
alt_en: How much is it to get the screen replaced at the repair shop?
sentences.mn_latin: Zasvaryn gazar delgets soliulakhad khed bolokh ve?

sentences.en: My phone got stolen on the bus yesterday.
alt_en: My phone was stolen on the bus yesterday.

sentences.mn: Мөсөн дээр хальтирч унахдаа утсаа хагалж орхисон.
sentences.en: When I slipped on the ice, I ended up breaking my phone.
alt_mn: Мөсөн дээр хальтирч унаад утсаа хагалчихсан.
alt_en: I slipped on the ice and broke my phone.
sentences.mn_latin: Mösön deer khalitirch unakhdaa utsaa khagalj orkhison.

sentences.mn: Утасны гэр зузаан байсан болохоор дэлгэц нь бүтэн үлдсэн.
sentences.en: The case was thick, so the screen didn't get damaged.
alt_mn: Утасны гэр зузаан байсан тул дэлгэц нь гэмтээгүй.
alt_en: Because the case was thick, the screen stayed in one piece.
sentences.mn_latin: Utasny ger zuzaan baisan bolokhoor delgets ni büten üldsen.

sentences.mn: Дэлгэц хагарсан ч мэдрэгч нь хэвийн ажиллаж байна.
sentences.en: The screen got cracked, but the touchscreen still works fine.
alt_mn: Дэлгэц хагарсан боловч мэдрэгч нь хэвийн ажиллаж байна.
alt_en: The screen is cracked, but the touchscreen still works normally.
sentences.mn_latin: Delgets khagarsan ch medregch ni kheviin ajillaj baina.

sentences.mn: Яарч байгаад утсаа таксинд мартаж орхисон.
sentences.en: I was in a hurry and left my phone in the taxi.
alt_en: I was rushing and forgot my phone in the taxi.
sentences.mn_latin: Yaarch baigaad utsaa taksind martaj orkhison.

grammar.title_en: -ж/-ч орхих: "Oops, I went and did it!"
grammar.explain_en: In Mongolian, you add the converb ending -ж (or -ч after в, г, р, с) to a verb and follow it with орхих ("to leave, to throw aside"). This shows that an action happened suddenly, completely, or without you meaning it to: унагаж орхилоо "I (accidentally) dropped it," мартаж орхисон "I went and forgot it." Only орхих changes for tense: орхилоо for something that just happened, орхисон for the past. In casual speech the shorter -чих form means much the same thing: унагачихлаа. Also notice the verb pairs: хагарах "to crack (by itself)" and хагалах "to crack something."
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд "get + үйлийн гуравдугаар хэлбэр (V3)" нь гэнэт, санамсаргүй, ихэвчлэн таагүй тохиолдсон үйлийг илэрхийлдэг: My screen got cracked (Дэлгэц маань хагарчихлаа), My phone got stolen (Утсыг маань хулгайлчихлаа). Энэ хэлбэр нь "was cracked"-аас илүү ярианы, амьд сонсогддог. Цагийг get өөрөө харуулна: got (өнгөрсөн), will get (ирээдүй), is getting (одоо үргэлжилж буй). Араас нь заавал V3 хэлбэр орно: broken, stolen, cracked. "Got broke" гэж хэлэхгүйг санаарай.

examples.en: I went and left my keys at home.
Be careful, or your phone will get broken.

fill_blank.translation: I accidentally dropped my phone on the bus.
fill_blank.explain_en: After the -ж converb, орхих adds the meaning of a sudden, unintended action. Авах and өгөх have different meanings in this slot.
fill_blank.explain_mn: -ж нөхцөлийн араас орхих туслах үйл үг орж, санамсаргүй, гэнэт болсон үйлийг илэрхийлнэ. Авах, өгөх нь энэ байрлалд өөр утгатай.

fill_blank.translation: The phone fell, and its screen got cracked.
fill_blank.explain_en: The screen cracked by itself, so you need the intransitive verb хагарах, not хагалах ("to crack something"). Before байна it takes the completed form -чихсан.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Дэлгэц өөрөө хагарсан тул хагарах үйл үг тохирно. Хагалах гэвэл хэн нэгэн хагалсан гэсэн утгатай болно.

fill_blank.translation: It's hard to text on a phone with a cracked screen.
fill_blank.explain_en: Before a noun you need an adjective. Хагархай means "cracked, broken."
fill_blank.explain_mn: Нэр үгийн өмнө тэмдэг нэр орох ёстой. Хагархай нь "cracked" гэсэн утгатай тэмдэг нэр.

fill_blank.text: My screen ___ cracked when I dropped my phone yesterday.
fill_blank.translation: Өчигдөр утсаа унагахад дэлгэц маань хагарчихсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: This happened yesterday, so you need the past tense got + past participle.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Өчигдөр болсон үйл тул get-ийн өнгөрсөн цагийн хэлбэр got орно.

fill_blank.text: My phone got ___ on the bus.
fill_blank.explain_en: Get-passive needs the past participle: steal, stole, stolen.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Get-ийн араас үйл үгийн гуравдугаар хэлбэр (V3) орно: steal – stole – stolen.

fill_blank.text: Use a case, or your phone will get ___.
fill_blank.translation: Гэр хэрэглээрэй, тэгэхгүй бол утас чинь эвдэрчихнэ.
fill_blank.explain_en: After will get, use the past participle broken. "Will get broke" is incorrect.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Will get-ийн араас V3 хэлбэр broken орно. Broke бол өнгөрсөн цагийн хэлбэр.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Болд оо, яагаад ийм гунигтай байгаа юм бэ?
dialogue.en: Bold, why do you look so upset?
dialogue.mn_latin: Bold oo, yaagaad iim gunigtai baigaa yum be?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Өглөө автобусанд түлхэлцээд утсаа унагаж орхилоо.
dialogue.en: This morning I got pushed on the bus and dropped my phone.
dialogue.mn_latin: Öglöö avtobusand tülkheltseed utsaa unagaj orkhiloo.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Өө, хөөрхий. Дэлгэц нь хагарсан уу?
dialogue.en: Oh no. Did the screen crack?
dialogue.mn_latin: Öö, khöörkhii. Delgets ni khagarsan uu?

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, булангаараа хагарчихсан. Хамгаалалтын шил ч наагаагүй байсан.
dialogue.en: Yeah, it got cracked at the corner. I didn't even have a screen protector on it.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, bulangaaraa khagarchikhsan. Khamgaalaltyn shil ch naagaagüi baisan.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Ажиллаж байна, гэхдээ хагархай дэлгэцээр мессеж бичихэд хэцүү байна.
dialogue.en: It works, but texting on a cracked screen is hard.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ajillaj baina, gekhdee khagarkhai delgetseer myessyej bichikhed khetsüü baina.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Манай байрны доод давхарт засварын газар бий. Нэг цагийн дотор дэлгэц сольж өгдөг.
dialogue.en: There's a repair shop on the ground floor of my building. They replace screens within an hour.
dialogue.mn_latin: Manai bairny dood davkhart zasvaryn gazar bii. Neg tsagiin dotor delgets solij ögdög.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Үнэхээр үү? Ажлын дараа очъё. Баярлалаа!
dialogue.en: Really? I'll go after work. Thanks!
dialogue.mn_latin: Ünekheer üü? Ajlyn daraa ochyo. Bayarlalaa!

culture_note.en: Ulaanbaatar's buses can get very crowded at rush hour, and in winter the sidewalks are often covered in ice, so dropped phones and cracked screens are very common. That's why small phone repair stalls are everywhere in shopping centers and markets. Most of them replace a screen in about an hour, and many people get a screen protector and a sturdy case right after buying a new phone.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарын автобус ачаалалтай цагаар их дүүрдэг, өвөл явган зам ихэвчлэн мөстэй байдаг тул утсаа унагаж, дэлгэцээ хагалах явдал их түгээмэл. Тийм ч учраас худалдааны төв, зах болгонд утас засварын жижиг цэг олон бий. Ихэнх нь дэлгэцийг нэг цаг орчимд сольж өгдөг бөгөөд олон хүн шинэ утас авмагцаа хамгаалалтын шил наалгаж, бат бөх гэр авдаг.

review.notes: A strong, accurate lesson with natural Mongolian and English. The one real fix is the misleading English idiom in sentence 0.

opus_fix.notes: Mostly solid. Fixed a wrong case in an alternative, the spelling of -вий, and en/mn parity in one explanation and the culture note.

changes.why: The alternative is a duplicate with a wrong case form: 'гарнаас' should be 'гараас', which is the main sentence.
The particle -вий is written attached to the verb.
Makes the Mongolian explanation match the English one.
Matches the Mongolian: 'ихэнх нь' means 'most', and 'олон хүн' means 'many people'.
'The touch still works' is unnatural English.
